Hi Carlos / Maya,

Thanks for the specifics — answering inline: 

1) Encryption at rest: We use AES-256 with cloud KMS. For hosted API and Dedicated, keys are managed by the cloud provider by default (provider-managed KMS). We offer customer-managed keys (CMK) for Dedicated and Private deployments under enterprise contracts; please let us know if FinSight requires CMK and we can escalate.

2) Evidence: The Type II attestation includes control descriptions and testing results. For routine operational evidence (vulnerability scan summaries, access review logs index), we provide redacted summaries and an evidence index — not raw logs. We will include the last 3 months of scan summaries in the intake bundle.

3) Timeline: We can create a secure Drive share within 3 business days. We'll place: SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), bridge letter (PDF + Docx), scope summary (one-pager), evidence index (CSV), and vuln-scan-summaries.zip (redacted).

One-line replies for your internal teams (pick as needed): 

- Procurement paste: "SOC2 Type II report available; audit period 2025-11-01—2026-10-31; Drive share to be provided; scope: Hosted API + Dedicated."
- Security paste: "Encryption: AES-256 with provider-managed KMS by default; CMK available for Dedicated/Private under enterprise agreement; vuln scan summaries and evidence index to be provided (redacted)."

If it's helpful, we can also provide a short control-to-requirement mapping for specific SIG/CAIQ questions — tell us which sections you care about and we'll prioritize.

I'll start the Drive prep and share the link to procurement and security.
